data.evidence: The report mentions that 'a deficit of (£0.5m) on direct business (2018: £1.7m surplus) and (£0.5m) on reinsurance accepted business (2018: £1.8m surplus) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.' This gives a net prior year development of -£1.0m (net basis). However, opening reserves for prior year development calculation should be on a gross basis. Gross opening claims outstanding = £93,512k. Net prior year development = -£1.0m. Percentage = -1,000 / 93,512 * 100 = -1.07%. But the report does not explicitly state a single prior year development figure on a gross basis, making this calculation uncertain. Model B's value of -0.214 does not match any derivable calculation from the available data.
